ammonia.reason: Ammonia from amino acid deamination by NSLAB during long ripening, limited by low aw 28.7% moisture and 3.29% salt.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-Cresol/indole from pasture and branched-chain fatty acids from lamb/kid rennet paste lipase.

bitter.reason: Bitter hydrophobic peptides from chymosin on ovine alpha-s1 casein plus high NaCl accentuating bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; 2-heptanone/2-nonanone blue-ketone pathway absent.

browning.reason: Very low residual lactose limits Maillard; some color from free amino groups and fat oxidation on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl from lactococcal citrate metabolism largely reduced to acetoin/2,3-butanediol over 6-12 mo aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very high butanoic/hexanoic acids 10-45 mmol/kg from pregastric lipase in lamb rennet paste lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: Low 28.7% moisture and 29% protein dense matrix with crystallized fat limits oral lubrication.

crumbliness.reason: Low moisture plus extensive proteolysis and calcium-phosphate solubilization fractures para-casein matrix.

firmness.reason: Low moisture 28.7%, cooked/pressed curd and 6-12 mo drying hardens Ca-linked protein network.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker degradation by NSLAB.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from NSLAB esterases esterifying free fatty acids with ethanol (~14% of volatiles).

goaty.reason: Caprylic/capric acids from ovine milk lipolysis; lower 4-methyloctanoic goaty note than goat milk.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal from Leu/Ile catabolism during extended proteolysis give nutty note.

melt.reason: Aged pH 5.14 demineralized and proteolyzed network softens but flows poorly with fat separation.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Minimal 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one without Penicillium/Geotrichum surface mold linoleic oxidation.

oil_off.reason: High 35.65% fat, 50% fat-in-dry-matter with coalesced globules and free fatty acids leaks oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Traditional light shrub-wood smoking deposits guaiacol/syringol phenols per PDO practice.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from raw-milk LAB plus minor acetic acid from heterofermentative lactobacilli at pH 5.14.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading and highly proteolyzed low-pH casein cannot form aligned stretchable fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide from methionine catabolism; mild cook gives little H2S.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted; slight sweetness only from free Pro/Ala and glycerol, masked by 3.29% salt.

umami.reason: High free glutamate and savory peptides from chymosin/plasmin and Lactobacillus proteolysis of 29% protein.
